reference_runtime_effect_surface.promotion_requires: The canonical reference runtime must expose exactly the current pipeline effect responsibility surface before it can serve as the semantic parity oracle for native-v2 promotion. Missing current effects or retained legacy alternate effects keep admission fail-closed.

required: pipeline_profile_read is a real handler, not an effect-name alias
pipeline_profile_read reads canonical profile state through entity_db/MiniUnifiedDB
external profile-file loading is configuration/import only and is not a runtime effect authority
inference_generate is a real generic handler, not a provider_chat_json alias
inference_generate consumes runtime inference configuration rather than a fixed provider responsibility
legacy _profile_load and _provider_chat_json handlers are deauthorized from the reference runtime
reference_runtime_authority_semantics.promotion_requires: Effect-name parity is necessary but insufficient. The reference runtime must also transfer profile authority to entity_db/MiniUnifiedDB and inference responsibility to the generic inference configuration path. A string-only rename must remain fail-closed.

promotion_requires: canonical_reference_runtime_authority_semantics match DB-profile and generic-inference responsibilities; effect-name aliases alone are insufficient
